_comment: Class starter kits (design/gdd/race-gear-sets.md 3.2-3.3, Boss 2026-11-13; built by tools/items/build_race_gear.py). Every class card starts wearing its OWN race's starter outfit at tier `tier` (white): `kits` maps class -> slot -> a catalog id, {race} = the card's race. `offhand`: the starter shield of a card whose offhand slot is open (Sword & Shield), {race} likewise. logic/profile.gd: new players get the kit; old saves get it once (starter_kit_version) in EMPTY slots only. Accessories start empty. The neutral starter pieces and round_shield are gone (Boss 2026-11-13).
